# Ninja 360 Digital Media

> Ninja 360 Digital Media is a Kansas City Northland local-visibility system. We help
> local businesses get found and chosen on Google with professional media (drone
> photography and video, Google 360 virtual tours, Matterport, product video) and
> ongoing Google Business Profile optimization. Our method is the M.A.P. System:
> Make (capture the right visuals), Amplify (publish to Google), Promote (keep you
> visible). Tagline: "We put you on the M.A.P." Founded and run by Tim Petet, a Google
> Certified Photographer and FAA Part 107 drone pilot based in Gladstone, Missouri.

## Business identity (canonical NAP — matches every listing)

- Social handle: @ninja360net
- Primary category: Drone service (drone photography)
- Secondary categories: Virtual tours, Commercial photographer, Digital marketing agency
- Founder: Tim Petet, Google Certified Photographer, FAA Part 107
- Service area: Gladstone, Liberty, North Kansas City, Parkville, Smithville, Kearney,
  and Kansas City, Missouri (Northland first; greater Kansas City metro by arrangement)
- Positioning: a local VISIBILITY system, not a "virtual tour company." Drone, tours,
  and video are the proof; the product is getting local businesses found and chosen.
- No paid ads, no social-media management. Google-first.

## Offer (Belt System V3, effective 2026-10-22)
- Free Visibility Audit — every engagement starts here: https://ninja360.net/#section-JXWJCHUYEK
- White Belt "Get on the map": $300 build (one shoot + Google 360 tour + GBP optimization + an
  "Inside" page on ninja360.net), then $99/month for 6 months of listing upkeep.
- Brown Belt "Get chosen": $1,000 build (adds custom Kuula tour, product video, citations, and
  missed-call text-back / review requests / booking via GoHighLevel), then $299/month for 12 months.
- Black Belt "Facilities Ninja": Matterport digital twins and asset capture for multi-site and
  facilities clients. By invitation; custom scope.
- Add-ons: cinematic shots, drone video packs, FPV, seasonal refresh shoots.
